tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Start a Paseo coding agent whose product is a pull request. The provider is pinned by the broker; supplying provider, model, argv or cwd is rejected.

workspace.description: workspaceId or workspace name; omit for the current workspace

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Metadata for one Paseo agent. Returns no logs and no repository content.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the Paseo agents on this host as metadata only (id, workspace, title, status, provider, timestamps, PR url).

tools.name: send_agent_prompt
tools.description: Send a follow-up prompt to an existing Paseo agent.
